1.title: Trump Air Force One Photos Fuel Kennedy Center Demolition Speculation
1.summary: Images captured through the windows of Air Force One showed President Trump reviewing a poster with the title “Kennedy Center DEMOLISHED.”

2.title: At Gettysburg, a Reporter Captured a Nation’s Loss, and His Own
2.summary: Samuel Wilkeson Jr. filed a report for The Times from the battlefield. Then he went looking for a Union officer, his son.

3.title: Jon Kyl, Senator Known for His Skills Behind the Scenes, Dies at 84
3.summary: The Arizona politician rose to the second-highest position in the Republican-held Senate caucus thanks to his policy smarts and deft political sensibilities.

4.title: U.S. Strike on Iranian School May Have Been War Crime, U.N. Report Says
4.summary: Mistakes that led to the deaths of more than a hundred children “went beyond negligence,” investigators said. They also cited a separate strike the same day that killed a reported 22 civilians.

5.title: Major Iranian Airline Suspends Several Flights Abroad, Adding to Isolation
5.summary: The carrier, Mahan Air, said it would stop flying to neighboring countries just over a week after the United States imposed sweeping sanctions on Iran’s aviation industry.

6.title: Russia and China Veto U.S. Bid to Renew U.N. Monitoring of Iran Nuclear Program
6.summary: The conflict underscored the distance between world powers over the United States’ pressure campaign on Iran.
